notes.title: First Localized Version!
notes.notes:
We have just uploaded the first fully localized version to the default branch of the playtest!

It would be great if you'd try it out and share your feedback on our Discord:
https://discord.gg/pixel-maniacs

If there is some wording in a language (Besides English and German), please post them in the channel #playtest-issues.

Thanks a lot for your participation!
